title: Intern, Trade Promotion Management Business and Data Analyst
description: Intern, Trade Promotion Management Business and Data Analyst Location: Georgetown, ON, Mississauga, ON Remote Type: Hybrid Time Type: Full time Job Description At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best? Saputo’s people bring expertise, talent and passion to a leading global dairy processor. You’ll work alongside a committed team, contribute to meaningful work and build skills through hands-on experience. The Trade Promotion Management Business and Data Analyst Intern will support Phase II of the SUSA TPM implementation, focused on promotion planning, tracking and optimization. The intern will help validate volume plans, promotion scenarios, trade budgets, reporting and post-event performance, working with IT and cross-functional business teams. The role provides exposure to the TPM lifecycle and supports promotional forecast accuracy, spending control and effectiveness. The Internship Program will run from May 10 to August 13, 2027. HOW YOU WILL MAKE CONTRIBUTIONS THAT MATTER… Develop and execute functional and end-to-end tests for planning, funding, budgets, approvals, execution, actualization, reporting and post-event analysis; validate data and document defects and retesting. Maintain traceability across requirements, design, configuration, interfaces, tests, defects and sign-off; prepare process documentation and training materials and support deployment and hypercare. YOU ARE BEST SUITED FOR THE ROLE IF YOU… Education: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree or college diploma in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Business Technology Management, Data Analytics, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, Computer Science or a related field. Skills: Strong Excel skills, including data cleansing, pivot tables, lookups, variance analysis and reconciliation; comfort with large datasets and business measures. SAP, Vistex, TPM, demand-planning, Power BI or Microsoft Fabric exposure is an asset. Testing, documentation, communication, organization and confidentiality are important. AT SAPUTO, YOU WILL… Write the future of the industry: Work with a team seeking better and more efficient ways to meet industry challenges. Have an impact on day one: Contribute through hands-on work and the talents you bring. Grow in your own way: Develop your skills and explore your career path through the internship. Saputo supports employment equity and strives to embed diversity and inclusion in its operations. Candidates from all backgrounds are invited to apply. SALARY RANGE Starting at $21.90 per hour In Canada, Saputo is a leading cheese manufacturer and fluid milk and cream processor, with a portfolio of well-loved brands such as Dairyland, Armstrong, Neilson, Alexis de Portneuf, and many more. Whether your expertise lies in manufacturing, operations, supply chain management, sales, quality assurance, or in any other function, your role is integral to our success. You will make contributions that matter, all while working alongside colleagues who genuinely care about your success and who will roll up their sleeves to help.
